This practical course is for all diploma students of the Technical College.
It builds the digital skills that everyone needs for study, work and daily
life: the apps that make us productive, your university account, cloud
storage and files, **Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint**, and **AI tools**
(such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT and Gemini) to write documents, work with
data and design presentations, safely and honestly.

**A blended course.** Each unit has two sessions:

- a **face-to-face session** in the computer lab: a lecture with its
  **worksheet** (PDF), where you do experiments on the computer and record
  your results, its notes, an interactive page and slides; or a practice
  session on earlier lectures;
- an **online activity**: an interactive lesson, simulators or a short video
  on its page, then the tasks that you submit on the university e-learning
  platform by the date on its page.

**Textbook.** Evans, A., Martin, K. and Poatsy, M. A. *Technology in Action*,
Global Edition, 18th ed., Pearson, 2024. References: Lambert and Frye,
*Microsoft Office Step by Step (Office 2021 and Microsoft 365)*, 2022;
Microsoft 365 Training (support.microsoft.com/training); UNESCO, *Guidance
for Generative AI in Education and Research*, 2023.

**How to study.** Read the lesson notes (PDF) before and after the lab
lecture, and practise on the interactive page: it has simulators and
questions with instant feedback. The slides are a short summary for
revision.

## Units

The course in 15 weeks, in teaching order: 10 units and 5 practice weeks.
The course is practical and blended: each week has a face-to-face session of
60 minutes in the computer lab and an online activity (💻 Online) with tasks
to submit on the e-learning platform. Each unit has a lecture with new
skills and an online activity that practises them. A practice week (dashed,
tagged *Flexible*) has no new ideas: a practice session in the lab and an
online practice activity. It is taught when time allows; otherwise study it
at home, because every answer is on the page. Faded sessions are not
available yet.
